text:
This man, whom you loudly acclaim (O Bulequino!)
as John of Austria, in a prominent
august city: a young man exalted
(if humane to all) is divine.


Maborte girded him with fine steel,
his victorious, all-powerful sword;
let Flanders say it, let it speak eloquently,
let Parthenope and Barcelona say it.


Today, clothed in peace and glory,
we see him as peerless arbiter
of Justice in all contingencies.


O Buluquino, you who travel the world
observing all its wonders:
since there is nothing more to see, take no more steps.

translation.title: This, Whom You Hail Aloud (O Bulequino!)
